meta.name: migrate-from-v1
meta.description: Finish migrating a NanoClaw v1 install into v2. Run after `bash migrate-v2.sh` completes. Seeds the owner, migrates legacy memory, reconciles container configs, and helps port custom v1 code. Triggers on "migrate from v1", "finish migration", "v1 migration".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在将 NanoClaw v1 升级到 v2
copy.tagline_en: Finish migrating NanoClaw from v1 to v2
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are upgrading NanoClaw from v1 to v2

howto.what: Claude 会接手 NanoClaw v1 到 v2 的迁移收尾:先确认迁移脚本已运行,再依次帮你确认管理员、迁移旧记忆、核对容器配置、处理自定义代码,最后验证并重启服务。
howto.when: 当你提到“migrate from v1”“finish migration”“v1 migration”中任意一个,并且已用 `bash migrate-v2.sh` 完成迁移时,Claude 会接管收尾。

say.text: 帮我完成从 v1 到 v2 的迁移
say.note: Claude 会检查迁移脚本是否已运行,然后开始收尾。

say.text: 我是管理员,请把我的账号设为 owner
say.note: Claude 会查询用户并授予 owner 角色。

say.text: 迁移我的旧记忆和自定义代码
say.note: Claude 会执行记忆迁移并帮你处理分叉定制。

howto.what_en: Claude will take over finishing the NanoClaw v1-to-v2 migration: first verify the migration script has run, then help confirm the admin, migrate old memory, reconcile container configs, handle custom code, and finally verify and restart the service.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say phrases like "migrate from v1", "finish migration", or "v1 migration", and after `bash migrate-v2.sh` has completed.

say_en.text: Help me finish the migration from v1 to v2
say_en.note: Claude checks the script ran, then finishes up.

say_en.text: I'm the admin, please set my account as owner
say_en.note: Claude queries users and grants the owner role.

say_en.text: Migrate my old memory and custom code
say_en.note: Claude runs memory migration and helps port fork changes.
